meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to work', paired with 'поработать'.

examples.text: Она сегодня работает одна в прачечной.
examples.trans: She is working alone in the laundry room today.

examples.text: Ладно, мне уже пора идти работать.
examples.trans: Alright, it is time for me to go work already.

examples.text: А вам нужно быстро идти работать!
examples.trans: And you need to quickly go work!

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'смотреть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'look', paired with 'смотреть'.

examples.text: Можно я посмотрю?
examples.trans: May I have a look?

examples.text: Я только посмотрел.
examples.trans: I only had a look.

examples.text: А можно я пойду посмотрю?
examples.trans: Can I go and have a look?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'there', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Чай лежит вон там за баром.
examples.trans: The tea is over there behind the bar.

examples.text: Настя, посмотри, что это там внизу?
examples.trans: Nastya, look, what is that down there?

examples.text: Ждите меня там и обрабатывайте землю.
examples.trans: Wait for me there and cultivate the land.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'downstairs, below, at the bottom', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Да, шеф, я внимательно вас слушаю.
examples.trans: Yes, chef, I am listening to you attentively.

examples.text: Да, конечно, я вас внимательно слушаю.
examples.trans: Yes, of course, I am listening to you attentively.

examples.text: Вот, посмотри внимательно на этот листок.
examples.trans: Here, look closely at this sheet of paper.
